main.title: COP31 Talks Collapse in Turkey in a Clash Over Fossil Fuels
main.summary: European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas.

related.title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed
related.summary: The prime minister of Australia, which co-hosted COP31, attributed the failure to "difficult geopolitical times".

related.title: COP31 climate talks in Turkey collapse
related.summary: EU member states on Sunday objected to adopting an 11th-hour deal that omitted explicit references to fossil fuels, the bloc's presidency said. The issue remains a major point of contention at the summit, which is taking place amid soaring energy prices and geopolitical tensions fuelled by the war in Iran.

related.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
related.summary: The talks have been the longest-running in the summit's history, with negotiations breaking down two days after they had been due to end.
